name: Report Arena
description: The clinical adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical diagnostics is critically hampered by its black-box nature, which prevents clinicians from verifying the rationale behind automated decisions. To overcome this fundamental barrier, we introduce DeepMedix-R1, a foundation model (FM) for chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation that generates not only accurate diagnoses but also a transparent, step-by-step reasoning process grounded in specific visual evidence.
